ask_mechanic.en: A {cause} is one possibility based on these symptoms. What test can confirm it? Please show me the result before replacing any parts.
ask_mechanic.roman_ur: In alamat ki bunyaad par {cause} mumkin wajah hai. Is ki tasdeeq ke liye konsa test ho sakta hai? Parts badalne se pehle test ka result dikha dein.

disclaimer.en: This is guidance, not a confirmed diagnosis. A qualified mechanic should inspect the vehicle; ask for proof before approving repairs.
disclaimer.roman_ur: Yeh rehnumai hai, tasdeeq shuda tashkhees nahi. Gaari mechanic se check karwayein aur repair ki ijazat se pehle saboot maangein.
